name: run-shell-and-commit

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      target_file:
        description: '要执行的 .sh 文件（仓库相对路径），留空则扫描全部 *.sh'
        required: false
        default: ''
      output_dir:
        description: '生成文件保存目录（仓库相对路径）'
        required: true
        default: 'generated'

jobs:
  run-and-commit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: prepare output dir
        run: mkdir -p "${{ github.event.inputs.output_dir }}"

      - name: run shell scripts
        run: |
          set -e
          if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.target_file }}" ]; then
            scripts="${{ github.event.inputs.target_file }}"
          else
            scripts=$(find . -name "*.sh" -type f)
          fi
          for s in $scripts; do
            echo "Running $s"
            bash "$s"
          done

      - name: commit generated files
        run: |
          git config user.name  "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add "${{ github.event.inputs.output_dir }}"
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit"
          else
            git commit -m "Automated: save generated files"
            git push
          fi
